paragraphs.source_en: Katsushige thought they should summon Ii Naotaka once more. So long as they could silence Naotaka, the matter would be easily handled. But an unexpected accusation had come from another quarter, and Honda Masazumi had already begun investigating the matter on his own. The informant was the mother of Kunimatsumaru's playmate—Sōgo's wife. Sōgo must have feared that the affair would bring ruin upon the house he served, and so had sent his wife to report it.

units.source_en: Katsushige thought they should summon Ii Naotaka once more.
units.source_zh: 胜重认为，当再请来井伊直孝。

units.source_en: So long as they could silence Naotaka, the matter would be easily handled.
units.source_zh: 只要封住直孝的口，事情就好办了。

units.source_en: But an unexpected accusation had come from another quarter, and Honda Masazumi had already begun investigating the matter on his own.
units.source_zh: 但因意外地有他人告发，本多正纯已单独对此事开始调查。

units.source_zh: 告发人便是国松丸的玩伴之母——宗语之妻。

units.source_en: Sōgo must have feared that the affair would bring ruin upon the house he served, and so had sent his wife to report it.
units.source_zh: 宗语怕是害怕此事会连累到主家，才让妻子出来告发。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜重认为，当再请来井伊直孝。只要封住直孝的口，事情就好办了。但因意外地有他人告发，本多正纯已单独对此事开始调查。告发人便是国松丸的玩伴之母——宗语之妻。宗语怕是害怕此事会连累到主家，才让妻子出来告发。

paragraphs.source_en: Outwardly, Sōtaku's wife pleaded for her son's life, but in truth she was exonerating the Kyōgoku, declaring that they had nothing whatever to do with the affair.

units.source_en: Outwardly, Sōtaku's wife pleaded for her son's life, but in truth she was exonerating the Kyōgoku, declaring that they had nothing whatever to do with the affair.
units.source_zh: 宗泽之妻表面上请求饶恕儿子，实则在为京极开脱，言明京极与此事毫无干系。

paragraphs.source_zh: 宗泽之妻表面上请求饶恕儿子，实则在为京极开脱，言明京极与此事毫无干系。

paragraphs.source_en: Masazumi immediately sought out Ii and confirmed the circumstances in which the two children had been captured. He then hastened to report the matter to Hidetada before proceeding himself to the residence of the shoshidai.

units.source_en: Masazumi immediately sought out Ii and confirmed the circumstances in which the two children had been captured. He then hastened to report the matter to Hidetada before proceeding himself to the residence of the shoshidai.
units.source_zh: 正纯马上寻到井伊，确认了两个孩子被捉时的情形，然后速将此事禀告了秀忠，自己则来到所司代府邸。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正纯马上寻到井伊，确认了两个孩子被捉时的情形，然后速将此事禀告了秀忠，自己则来到所司代府邸。

paragraphs.source_en: Masazumi had made up his mind. If the matter were debated too widely, Jōkō-in would inevitably fall under suspicion, implicating the Kyōgoku clan as well, and the affair could no longer be concealed. Under the old wartime precedent, Kunimatsu, as the son of a rebel, must receive the ultimate punishment, thereby displaying the majesty of the law to all the realm. In such circumstances, Hidetada would not ordinarily insist on overturning precedent.

units.source_en: Masazumi had made up his mind.
units.source_zh: 正纯主意已定。

units.source_en: If the matter were debated too widely, Jōkō-in would inevitably fall under suspicion, implicating the Kyōgoku clan as well, and the affair could no longer be concealed.
units.source_zh: 若议论太多，常高院势必被人怀疑，亦会连累京极氏，事情便无法隐瞒。

units.source_en: Under the old wartime precedent, Kunimatsu, as the son of a rebel, must receive the ultimate punishment, thereby displaying the majesty of the law to all the realm.
units.source_zh: 按战时旧例，国松当作为叛贼之子处以极刑，以向天下显示法令威严。

units.source_en: In such circumstances, Hidetada would not ordinarily insist on overturning precedent.

ja.t: そうとはしないはずだった。

units.source_zh: 在这种情况下，秀忠一般也不会强更旧例。

paragraphs.source_zh: 正纯主意已定。若议论太多，常高院势必被人怀疑，亦会连累京极氏，事情便无法隐瞒。按战时旧例，国松当作为叛贼之子处以极刑，以向天下显示法令威严。在这种情况下，秀忠一般也不会强更旧例。

paragraphs.source_en: “I have a matter to discuss with the shoshidai in secret. Announce me at once.” When Honda Masazumi arrived on horseback at Itakura Katsushige's residence, Kunimatsumaru was seated between Rokuzaemon and his wet nurse, smacking his lips over a steamed Wakasa flounder.

units.source_en: “I have a matter to discuss with the shoshidai in secret. Announce me at once.”
units.source_zh: “在下有事要与所司代秘密商议，速速通报。”

units.source_en: When Honda Masazumi arrived on horseback at Itakura Katsushige's residence, Kunimatsumaru was seated between Rokuzaemon and his wet nurse, smacking his lips over a steamed Wakasa flounder.
units.source_zh: 本多正纯骑着马赶到板仓胜重府邸时，国松丸正坐在六左卫门和乳母中间，对着若狭的蒸鲽鱼咂巴着嘴。

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下有事要与所司代秘密商议，速速通报。”本多正纯骑着马赶到板仓胜重府邸时，国松丸正坐在六左卫门和乳母中间，对着若狭的蒸鲽鱼咂巴着嘴。

paragraphs.source_en: Honda Masazumi and Itakura Katsushige conferred in secret for three hours in the study, with all four doors tightly shut. Throughout that time, even their personal pages and servants were forbidden to approach, yet the sound of fierce argument could still be heard from time to time.

units.source_en: Honda Masazumi and Itakura Katsushige conferred in secret for three hours in the study, with all four doors tightly shut.
units.source_zh: 本多正纯和板仓胜重在四门紧闭的书院里密谈了一个半时辰。

units.source_en: Throughout that time, even their personal pages and servants were forbidden to approach, yet the sound of fierce argument could still be heard from time to time.

ja.t: されなかったが、それでも

units.source_zh: 其间，二人的贴身侍童和下人均不得靠近，但仍时而听见他们激烈争吵。

paragraphs.source_zh: 本多正纯和板仓胜重在四门紧闭的书院里密谈了一个半时辰。其间，二人的贴身侍童和下人均不得靠近，但仍时而听见他们激烈争吵。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsushige argued that Kunimatsu should be spared, while Masazumi insisted upon the ultimate punishment. At last Ii Naotaka was summoned, followed later by Andō Shigenobu. Thus the number favoring execution continued to grow, leaving Itakura Katsushige increasingly isolated.

units.source_en: Katsushige argued that Kunimatsu should be spared, while Masazumi insisted upon the ultimate punishment.
units.source_zh: 胜重主张放过国松，正纯却坚持处以极刑。

units.source_en: At last Ii Naotaka was summoned, followed later by Andō Shigenobu.
units.source_zh: 到了最后，又请来了井伊直孝，后又叫来安藤重信。

units.source_en: Thus the number favoring execution continued to grow, leaving Itakura Katsushige increasingly isolated.
units.source_zh: 这样一来，主张处刑的人越来越多，板仓胜重则变得势单力薄。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜重主张放过国松，正纯却坚持处以极刑。到了最后，又请来了井伊直孝，后又叫来安藤重信。这样一来，主张处刑的人越来越多，板仓胜重则变得势单力薄。

paragraphs.source_en: But Katsushige refused to yield an inch. Before long, Shigenobu went to Fushimi Castle to ask for Shogun Hidetada's decision.

units.source_en: But Katsushige refused to yield an inch. Before long, Shigenobu went to Fushimi Castle to ask for Shogun Hidetada's decision.
units.source_zh: 但是胜重毫不让步，未久，重信便去了伏见城询问将军秀忠的决定。

paragraphs.source_zh: 但是胜重毫不让步，未久，重信便去了伏见城询问将军秀忠的决定。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long Shigenobu returned and proclaimed in a loud voice, “His Lordship the Shogun has decided. The law is to be carried out. Kunimatsumaru is to be beheaded on the riverbank at Rokujō.”

units.source_en: Before long Shigenobu returned and proclaimed in a loud voice, “His Lordship the Shogun has decided. The law is to be carried out.
units.source_zh: 未几，重信回来，大声道：“将军大人已经决断，要依法行事。

units.source_en: Kunimatsumaru is to be beheaded on the riverbank at Rokujō.”
units.source_zh: 国松丸应于六条河滩斩首。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 未几，重信回来，大声道：“将军大人已经决断，要依法行事。国松丸应于六条河滩斩首。”

paragraphs.source_en: In an instant, utter silence descended upon the room; only Katsushige's tears streamed ceaselessly down his face.

units.source_en: In an instant, utter silence descended upon the room; only Katsushige's tears streamed ceaselessly down his face.
units.source_zh: 一瞬间，全场鸦雀无声，只有胜重的泪水哗哗往下淌。

paragraphs.source_zh: 一瞬间，全场鸦雀无声，只有胜重的泪水哗哗往下淌。

paragraphs.source_en: “What of Tanaka Rokuzaemon?”

units.source_en: “What of Tanaka Rokuzaemon?”
units.source_zh: “田中六左卫门呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “田中六左卫门呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “He, of course, is to be beheaded as well. His careless words very nearly brought calamity upon his lord's house. Such conduct is utterly unworthy of a samurai.”

units.source_en: “He, of course, is to be beheaded as well.
units.source_zh: “当然也是斩首。

units.source_en: His careless words very nearly brought calamity upon his lord's house.
units.source_zh: 他话语随便，险些连累了主家。

units.source_en: Such conduct is utterly unworthy of a samurai.”

ja.t: として、あまりにもあるまじき

units.source_zh: 身为武士，太不应该。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “当然也是斩首。他话语随便，险些连累了主家。身为武士，太不应该。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Then...what of the wet nurse?”

units.source_en: “Then...what of the wet nurse?”
units.source_zh: “那么……乳母呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “那么……乳母呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “The wet nurse is a woman. She need not be punished.”

units.source_en: “The wet nurse is a woman. She need not be punished.”
units.source_zh: “乳母乃是女人，无须问罪。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “乳母乃是女人，无须问罪。”

paragraphs.source_en: “And the page...Sōgo's son?”

units.source_en: “And the page...Sōgo's son?”
units.source_zh: “侍童……宗语的儿子呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “侍童……宗语的儿子呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “That child...” Shigenobu broke off, tilted his head in thought, then said, “The Shogun ordered that he be beheaded with the others. Without anyone beside him, Kunimatsumaru would be all alone and forlorn on the road to the underworld.”

units.source_en: “That child...” Shigenobu broke off, tilted his head in thought, then said, “The Shogun ordered that he be beheaded with the others.
units.source_zh: “那个孩子……”重信话说到一半，侧首想了一想，道，“将军说，一起斩首。

units.source_en: Without anyone beside him, Kunimatsumaru would be all alone and forlorn on the road to the underworld.”

units.source_zh: 若无人陪着，国松丸在黄泉路孤苦伶仃，太寂寞。”

paragraphs.source_en: What a strange form of compassion. By established custom, rebellion was punishable by the extermination of the offender's entire clan, so such severity was hardly unusual. The Shogun's chief purpose in insisting on Kunimatsu's death was to intimidate the defeated soldiers still at large—unless they were shown the consequences, there was no telling what trouble they might cause. Yet to answer violence with violence alone was, with the slightest misstep, to become trapped in an endless cycle of bloodshed.

units.source_en: What a strange form of compassion.
units.source_zh: 这同情真是奇怪。

units.source_en: By established custom, rebellion was punishable by the extermination of the offender's entire clan, so such severity was hardly unusual.

ja.t: せられるものだから、これほどの

units.source_zh: 照例，谋反当罪诛九族，因此，这般严厉亦是常有之事。

units.source_en: The Shogun's chief purpose in insisting on Kunimatsu's death was to intimidate the defeated soldiers still at large—unless they were shown the consequences, there was no telling what trouble they might cause.

ja.t: がらせることにあった――ここで

units.source_zh: 将军之所以坚持处死国松，最大的目的是想震慑那些在逃的残兵败将——要是不给他们点颜色看看，还不知他们会惹出什么乱子。

units.source_en: Yet to answer violence with violence alone was, with the slightest misstep, to become trapped in an endless cycle of bloodshed.
units.source_zh: 但只是以暴制暴，稍有不慎，便会陷入暴力的轮回。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这同情真是奇怪。照例，谋反当罪诛九族，因此，这般严厉亦是常有之事。将军之所以坚持处死国松，最大的目的是想震慑那些在逃的残兵败将——要是不给他们点颜色看看，还不知他们会惹出什么乱子。但只是以暴制暴，稍有不慎，便会陷入暴力的轮回。

paragraphs.source_en: Itakura Katsushige rose with great care and passed down the long corridor. By the time he reached Kunimatsumaru's quarters, the hour of the boar had already passed. He had done all he could, but the tide could not be turned. The bitter irony was that he himself would have to carry out the decision.

units.source_en: Itakura Katsushige rose with great care and passed down the long corridor. By the time he reached Kunimatsumaru's quarters, the hour of the boar had already passed.
units.source_zh: 板仓胜重小心翼翼站起身来，穿过长长的走廊，来到国松丸住处时，已经过了亥时。

units.source_en: He had done all he could, but the tide could not be turned.

ja.t: くした。だが、もはやどうすることもできなかった。

units.source_zh: 他尽力了，却无力回天。

units.source_en: The bitter irony was that he himself would have to carry out the decision.

ja.t: しなければならないのは、ほかならぬ

units.source_zh: 颇具挖苦意味的是，须执行这个决定的，正是他本人。

paragraphs.source_zh: 板仓胜重小心翼翼站起身来，穿过长长的走廊，来到国松丸住处时，已经过了亥时。他尽力了，却无力回天。颇具挖苦意味的是，须执行这个决定的，正是他本人。

paragraphs.source_en: Before Katsushige's eyes arose the Rokujō riverbank in summer: unbearable heat, a blazing sun overhead, heaven and earth aflame, and only a single sparkling stream flowing silently through it all. Kunimatsumaru's pitiful little figure trod the scorching gravel, step by step, toward the place of death... What crime had this small child ever committed?

units.source_en: Before Katsushige's eyes arose the Rokujō riverbank in summer: unbearable heat, a blazing sun overhead, heaven and earth aflame, and only a single sparkling stream flowing silently through it all.
units.source_zh: 胜重眼前浮现出夏日的六条河滩，其热不堪，头顶上骄阳似火，天地如焚，唯一条闪闪发亮的清流静静流淌。

units.source_en: Kunimatsumaru's pitiful little figure trod the scorching gravel, step by step, toward the place of death... What crime had this small child ever committed?

paragraphs.source_en: Katsushige crossed the corridor and looked into the room. Kunimatsumaru had already fallen asleep beside Sōgo's child. Beside them, the wet nurse looked haggard as she used a round fan to drive away the mosquitoes.
